title: After years of false dawns, Big Tech, startups, and governments are betting on commercially useful quantum computers by 2030, as skeptics worry about hype (Michael Peel/Financial Times)
summary: Michael Peel / Financial Times: After years of false dawns, Big Tech, startups, and governments are betting on commercially useful quantum computers by 2030, as skeptics worry about hype — Companies are betting on big implications for pharmaceuticals, financial services and crypto. But sceptics worry about hype.
